name: Enquiry Genie
description: Chrome extension that drafts Airbnb/direct-booking enquiry replies in the host's tone with live pricing & availability (Gmail/Outlook + iCal/Airbnb sync). £1 for 14 days, then ~£29/mo for up to 5 properties. UK, bootstrapped.

mentions.evidence: ~$9.4k L30, ~$353k all-time, MRR listed as none / no active subscriptions. ~54 users claimed on profile, founded Apr 2025, UK. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Automate the repetitive guest/host (or clinic/patient) email that already has structured data (calendar + price). Stay in inbox; charge per property/location.
